title: How is Hitler connected to Bob Ross?
description: Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Bob Ross, through test pilot Hanna Reitsch, John F. Kennedy, a teenage Bill Clinton, Joe Biden and Phil Donahue.
hook: How is Hitler connected to Bob Ross?
fun_fact: On his 1994 show, Phil Donahue asked Bob Ross to admit his paintings would never hang in a museum. "Maybe it will," Ross said, "but probably not the Smithsonian." In 2019 the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History acquired four of his paintings.
research_note: Bob Ross almost never did talk shows (Joan Rivers in 1989, Regis and Kathie Lee in 1991-92, Donahue in 1994), and only the Donahue clip survives online, so the chain heads for Phil Donahue: Hitler's Iron Cross for Hanna Reitsch, her 1961 White House visit with the Whirly-Girls, JFK's 1963 handshake with a teenage Bill Clinton, then Clinton and Biden in 2023 and Biden's 2024 Medal of Freedom for Donahue. The 1992 AP photo of Clinton on Donahue's show only shows the back of Donahue's head, so the route goes through Biden's ceremony, where his face is clear.

links.line: In 1941, Hitler gave the Iron Cross to test pilot Hanna Reitsch.

image.credit: Robert Knudsen, White House Photographs, John F. Kennedy Presidential Library (JFKWHP-KN-C17738)

links.line: In 1961, Reitsch visited John F. Kennedy with women helicopter pilots.
In 1963, Kennedy shook hands with a teenage Bill Clinton.

where.place: White House Rose Garden, Washington, D.C.

links.line: In 2023, Clinton and President Joe Biden celebrated 30 years of family leave.

where.place: East Room, White House, Washington, D.C.

links.line: In 2024, Biden gave talk-show host Phil Donahue the Medal of Freedom.

where.place: East Room, White House, Washington, D.C.

links.line: And back in 1994, Donahue's talk show got a visit from Bob Ross.
